title: Statistics: Frequency Tables and Averages
seo_title: Statistics – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the mean, median, mode and range from frequency tables; draw and read pie charts. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on statistics: mean, median, mode and range from frequency tables, grouped data and pie charts. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Mode = value with the highest frequency.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In a frequency table, multiply each value by its frequency and add: Σfx. Mean = Σfx ÷ Σf.
  • The median is the middle value of all the data in order.
  • For grouped data, the modal class is the class with the highest frequency.

Examples

Example

Scores 1, 2, 3 with frequencies 4, 5, 1

Σfx = 4 + 10 + 3 = 17, Σf = 10

Answer: mean 1.7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the number of rowsDivide by the total frequency.
Taking the biggest frequency as the modeThe mode is the value, not the frequency.
Not ordering for the medianUse the cumulative frequency.
